pandas.merge_ordered

pandas 3.1.1 · General functions · function

Join ordered data such as time series, with optional forward-filling across the merged sequence.

  • Call syntax
  • Run the example
  • Parameters
  • Returns

Call syntax

pd.merge_ordered(…) Full signature
pd.merge_ordered(
    left,
    right,
    on=None,
    left_on=None,
    right_on=None,
    left_by=None,
    right_by=None,
    fill_method=None,
    suffixes=('_x', '_y'),
    how='outer',
)
